compiled_state.title: As a maintainer, I have a deterministic brainstorm replay test harness for verification
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Establish a deterministic brainstorm replay test harness under tests/brainstorm/ that can run /dso:brainstorm "<prompt>" non-interactively against a captured ticket-store fixture, with golden-output assertion helpers for the translation case, no-input case, and 7-sub-case decision tree calibration.

**Why**: S8 lists three replay tests (translation case, no-input feature, 7-sub-case calibration) plus structural tests as if the harness exists, but the codebase has no precedent for replay-style brainstorm tests. Without the harness, S8 expands 3-5x mid-sprint or ships as structural-only assertions that don't actually exercise the behavior the SCs require.

**Scope**:
- IN: Test harness at tests/brainstorm/ with non-interactive /dso:brainstorm invocation; captured ticket-store fixture (or recorded transcript); golden-output assertion helpers for translation case, no-input case, decision tree calibration; runner registration in test-batched.sh; harness executes one trivial replay end-to-end in CI.
- OUT: Replay tests themselves (covered by S8); LLM mocking infrastructure beyond what is needed for one trivial replay.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, tests/brainstorm/ directory exists with a documented harness layout, verified by structural test asserting tests/brainstorm/ exists with at least one test runner file.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"
- When this story is complete, the harness can execute one trivial /dso:brainstorm replay end-to-end against a captured ticket-store fixture (or recorded transcript) with golden-output assertion helpers; verified by running the harness against the trivial replay and asserting exit code 0.
  ← Satisfies: "Translation replay" (infrastructure prerequisite)
- When this story is complete, the harness is registered in test-batched.sh so it runs in CI; verified by structural test asserting the runner registration is present.
  ← Satisfies: "Cross-file structural consistency"

## Considerations

- [Testing] Replay tests are LLM-probabilistic; design the harness with multi-run aggregation or tolerate variance via canonical-marker assertions rather than full-output equality.
- [Reliability] If LLM mocking is not feasible, use recorded transcripts as the fixture; document this choice in the harness README.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
